blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — The Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) is intensifying its nationwide campaign against foreign nationals who allegedly obtain Philippine birth certificates through questionable late birth registrations, following the discovery of more than 46,000 records flagged for possible fraud.
